Sensory + communicationNoise, lighting, crowding, quiet spaces, sensory kits, visual supports, AAC-friendly participation and re-entry. Vision + hearingLarge print, audio description, tactile or verbal description, captions, ASL and assistive listening when confirmed. Practical careAccessible restrooms, changing equipment when published, parking, drop-off, seating, weather exposure and what remains unconfirmed.
